sentences.text: The Old Age Pension for the Poor and Widows of Chhattisgarh State Fund (OAPCWCSF) is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Chhattisgarh.
The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to elderly individuals and widows who are economically disadvantaged.
The primary objective is to enhance the quality of life for the elderly and widows by providing them with a monthly pension.
Eligible beneficiaries include poor elderly individuals aged 60 years and above and widows without any source of income.
The application process involves submitting a form along with necessary documents to the local government office or designated authority.
The pension is typically disbursed on a monthly basis.
The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Chhattisgarh.
Additional details regarding the exact amount of assistance and specific documentation requirements may vary and should be confirmed with local authorities.
